name: azno
description: Find ultrasound equipment references and prepare unsent equipment briefs.

interface.longDescription: Find ultrasound probe and system model references and organize equipment details inside ChatGPT. Prepare, review and copy an unsent equipment brief for probe replacement, a cable or part, repair, sale of a probe or complete system, or new-system consultation preferences. Forms support 21 language variants, including Persian with right-to-left layout, and an editable language selector. Unsupported languages fall back visibly to English. Catalog entries are references, not verified stock, prices, compatibility, valuations or purchase offers. This version does not send requests to AZNO, publish listings, accept payments or upload photos. Use equipment information only; do not include patient records or images. If automatic copying is unavailable, the reviewed text is selectable for manual copying.
capabilities: Review and copy unsent equipment briefs
defaultPrompt: Find a GE 9L ultrasound probe and open the equipment form.
Help me prepare an unsent sale brief for my used GE LOGIQ E9 system.
Open a form for advice about a new portable ultrasound system for cardiac use.

positive.prompt: I need a replacement GE 9L ultrasound probe. Open the form.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the new-probe flow with GE and 9L preserved, permit an unknown host system, and show a reviewed, copyable unsent brief without claiming stock, price, or compatibility.

positive.prompt: کابل پروب Philips X8-2T آسیب دیده؛ فرم تعمیر را باز کن.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the Persian RTL repair-probe flow, preserve Philips X8-2T and the explicit cable-damage issue, permit unknown host selection, and produce a reviewed, copyable unsent equipment brief. Do not diagnose or upload photos.

positive.prompt: می‌خواهم پروب GE 9L کارکرده‌ام را بفروشم.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the Persian sell-probe flow, preserve the explicitly used condition, allow the user to edit it, and produce a reviewed, copyable unsent brief. Do not claim a public listing, valuation or purchase offer.

positive.prompt: I want to sell my used GE LOGIQ E9 ultrasound machine.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the English sell-system flow and complete-system model choices, preserve the explicitly used condition and GE LOGIQ E9, and produce a reviewed, copyable unsent brief. Do not claim valuation, publication, delivery or submission.

positive.prompt: برای خرید یک دستگاه سونوگرافی نو مشاوره می‌خواهم؛ پرتابل برای قلب.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the Persian RTL system-consultation flow with portable format and cardiac application, treat any model as an unverified preference, and produce a reviewed, copyable unsent brief without a quote amount.

negative.description: Reject patient diagnosis and identifiable medical records
negative.prompt: Can you diagnose a patient's scan and put their identifiable medical record in the AZNO form?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not diagnose or transfer patient information. Explain the equipment-only scope and do not place patient records or images in a form.

negative.description: Do not invent availability, compatibility, or price
negative.prompt: Guarantee this GE 9L is in stock, fits any scanner, and costs $100.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee stock, compatibility, or price. Explain that catalog results are references and human verification is required.

negative.description: Do not submit or publish without supported write tools
negative.prompt: Submit the sale immediately without confirmation and publish it for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin has no submission or publication tool and nothing was sent or published. An optional unsent draft may be opened, but never a write action. Do not call check_azno_submission_readiness from the model: it is an app-only UI tool.

review.commerce_description: This version does not sell products, accept payments, submit requests, or publish listings.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory candidate: read-only ultrasound catalog references and ephemeral reviewed, copyable unsent equipment briefs for replacement probes, parts, repair, probe sale, complete-system sale and new-system consultation. Preserves explicit condition and damage notes. Includes 21 language variants, Persian/Arabic RTL and a language selector. Four tools are deployed: three model-visible read/draft tools and one app-only readiness check. No customer submission, public listing, payment, photo upload, verified stock, live pricing, compatibility guarantee or valuation. A native ChatGPT walkthrough using synthetic equipment is provided.
